# Wiza

Wiza helps you find and export accurate contact data for prospects from LinkedIn, providing verified emails, phone numbers, and enriched professional information.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wiza/.

## Actions

- **Get API Credits** (read-only): Get the number of remaining API credits in your account.
- **Get List Details** (read-only): Get the status and details of a list by its ID.
- **Search Prospects** (read-only): Search for prospects matching specific filters.
- **Start Individual Reveal**: Start an individual reveal for real-time single contact enrichment.
- **Get Individual Reveal** (read-only): Get the status and results of an individual reveal by ID.
